acs.text_first_line: AC1 The instruction element and the 2-working-day partner clock are fixed as data
AC2 The firm and instruction shape of rwb-partner is declared and never written here
AC3 The pack reference set of rwb-document is declared and no document is copied
AC4 The case read and the case-stage answer of rwb-case are declared
AC5 The two provided operations, the error envelope and the rights are fixed
AC6 The decision-record element, the clock and the idempotency rule are declared
AC7 The six contract fakes answer the document
AC8 The naming baseline, the no-v_ace_ boundary and the empty call types are fixed

the rwb-decision rule package read on /api/recovery/decision/v1 (operation name not specified in the source documents)
